The '''Temple of the Je'ulajists''' was established by the [[Kentra]] people, as a place of worship for the [[Holy Order of the Je'ulajists]]. Created from the wreckage of the ''[[Alpha Kentrum]]'', the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] which delivered [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Michael Tandre]] to the planet [[Orellon II]]; it was erected as a reminder to follow the tenets of [[Sword, Plow, and Spirit]].<ref name="TP" />
